mentions.name: Internal Combustion Engine Simulator
mentions.description: An internal combustion engine simulator built with applied CFD that simulates engine operation and sound, with audio demos (e.g., an inline-8 at 16000 RPM); not yet publicly released.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’m writing my own internal combustion engine simulator with some applied CFD. Nothing public yet but the sound is nice in my opinion:

https://glouw.com/2025/10/12/Ensim4.html
